additional_concerns: Several candidates move offering or promotional linkage into Scope. Under the declared runtime, a false condition then returns OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than the question's negative Boolean answer. This distinction needs explicit justification, especially for component questions whose stated actor scope is distributors.

The offer-level candidates node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 combine offer-level promotional linkage with an existential non-discount gift component. They need to establish that the same gift component has the required promotional connection; otherwise an unrelated benefit could be caught.
The SFC-authorised-fund scope has support in db43e253bea18.u0.2. It should not be presented as the full scope of paragraph 3.11, whose quoted wording covers investment products more generally.

The full Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and the answer to question 1 of the SFC's 30 September 2010 FAQ are not supplied as external dependencies. Footnotes 2 and 3 identify these authorities but do not supply their full contents.
A negative gift result, or TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT under the selected gift control, does not establish compliance with section 103, disclosure requirements, or advertising restrictions.
The retained packet supplies footnote 1, contrary to the disclosure claim's uncertainty annotation. Its cited Handbook provision remains an unsupplied external authority.
The supplied excerpts do not establish an effective-date interval. Temporal runtime safeguards do not independently establish which historical version applies.
